xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5516: pan conversations resume always fails locally with 'Missing origin'

plan.title: pan conversations resume always fails locally with 'Missing origin' (internal token not exempt from origin check)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: pan conversations resume posts to POST /api/conversations/:name/resume through callDashboard, which sends the internal token and no Origin. The route ran validateOrigin, which refuses such a POST with 'Missing origin'. The route also matched only the stored conversation name, so the numeric id and the conv- session name answered 'Conversation not found'.
narratives.Proposal: Use crossSiteWriteRefusal (the linked-conversation proxy rule: a valid internal token or access token skips the Origin check) on the resume route, and resolve the route key with the existing resolveConversationKey (numeric id, stored name, conv- session name) before calling handleConversationResume with the stored name.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to validateOriginHeaders or to any other route's origin check
- No change to pan conversations move or heal (tracked in PAN-5523)
- No new credential check beyond crossSiteWriteRefusal

items.title: Resume route accepts the internal token without an Origin

narrative.Action: Replace validateOrigin with crossSiteWriteRefusal in postConversationResumeRoute and add route tests for the internal-token and no-credential cases.

items.title: Given a POST to /api/conversations/:name/resume with only a valid internal token header, when the route runs, then it answers 200 and calls handleConversationResume
Given a POST to the resume route with no Origin and either no credential or a wrong internal token, when the route runs, then it answers 403 with error Missing origin and never calls the handler
Resume route resolves numeric id and conv- session name

narrative.Action: Export resolveConversationKey and use it in the resume route to map the key to the stored name before calling handleConversationResume.

items.title: Given a stored conversation, when the resume route receives its numeric id, then handleConversationResume is called with the stored name
Given a stored conversation, when the resume route receives its conv- session name, then handleConversationResume is called with the stored name
Given an unknown key, when the resume route runs with the real handler, then the handler receives the key unchanged and the route answers 404
Add the changelog.d entry for PAN-5516

narrative.Action: Write changelog.d/pan-5516.md with one Fixed bullet and no em dashes. No other documented surface changes: the route path, scope and CLI verb are unchanged.
